summary: Verified Dreyv Next.js preview fix against the LIVE preview URL. All 5 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) Home HTTP 200 in ~0.2s (no 502), (2) title 'AI Treasury Operating System for Web3' + 'Command-Ops' hero + all 8 nav links (Platform, Atlas, Developers, MCP, Pricing, FAQ, Try Atlas, Start free) present, (3) 3 back-to-back reloads all HTTP 200 in <300ms (production caching working), (4) /pricing HTTP 200 (103KB body) and /waitlist HTTP 200 (72KB body) render real content, (5) supervisor frontend log shows `next start` (production) running, no critical errors — only expected warnings (Missing TAVILY/JINA/FIRECRAWL keys, bigint pure JS fallback, Supabase Node20 deprecation notice). Old workerd/miniflare SQLite BUSY errors and ENOENT routes-manifest.json errors are historical (from earlier dev-mode attempts before the fix) and no longer occurring under the current production `next start` process.
critical_code_review_comments: Optional: consider adding `allowedDevOrigins` in next.config.ts if ever running dev mode again (currently irrelevant in prod).
Optional: the ox/viem 'Critical dependency' webpack warnings are non-blocking but noisy; can be suppressed via webpack config if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App runs via `yarn start` -> `next start -p 3000 -H 0.0.0.0` (production). Build output at /app/.next. next.config.ts has the initOpenNextCloudflareForDev() call commented out — leaving it enabled crashes build with workerd SQLite BUSY. Backend supervisor program is FATAL by design (no FastAPI backend in this Next.js app).
